Subject: MAP: Security milestones, DPA redlines & retention annex (Crestline)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I attached an updated mutual action plan (MAP) that focuses the next two weeks on the security/compliance gates we need to clear for final signoff. High-level asks for Crestline: SOC 2 evidence index, SIG/CAIQ responses for our hosted offering, DPA redline feedback + confirmation on the requested data retention windows (see annex).

Preliminary timeline I recommend:
- Week 0 (this week): Crestline to return DPA redlines and retention window preference (30/90/365 day standard options)
- Week 1: Security intake — provide SOC 2 evidence CSV linked to our evidence index; Redwood to provide SIG stub answers
- Week 2: Legal alignment + final mutual acceptance for onboarding (canary in Dedicated or Private per your preference)

Can you confirm owners on your side for the DPA and SOC2 evidence? Also attaching a fresh MAP spreadsheet (v3) with milestone owners and an embedded DPA redline tab for quick commenting.

Attachments: [Crestline_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 46KB)]

Thanks — I looped Neha for technical intake and Eli for procurement cadence.

Looping in internal owners and a quick ops plan.

Ben — can you pick up DPA redline review once Eli sends? Laura/legal: we expect a small set of commercial carveouts (export controls + EU data residency question if they push for that later). I recommend we prepare two DPA response tracks: (A) standard Redwood hosted DPA with the retention annex (90/365) and (B) a narrow carveout for EU residency if they request — that keeps time to close predictable.

Technical intake: I’ll open a secure evidence intake bucket and provide the SOC 2 control mapping CSV (attached) so Crestline's security team can align artifacts to controls. Once we receive their evidence index, I’ll triage mismatches and identify immediate gaps that can be mitigated by contractual SLOs or compensating controls.

Proposed working session: Thu 11/22 10:00am PT — 30 minutes to go through DPA redlines + the SOC2 evidence index outputs. Jordan, if you can confirm with Samantha/Eli, I’ll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read (evidence mapping + outstanding gaps).

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps based on your notes:

1) DPA: Crestline to send redlines by EOD Wed 11/22 — Ben and Laura will review and return our counter by Thu 11/23 morning. We will target a final DPA signoff in the mutual action plan by Tue 11/28 assuming no novel carveouts.

2) SOC 2 evidence: Crestline to provide initial evidence index Fri 11/24. Neha will run the mapping and escalate any critical gaps; non-critical items will be handled via contractual commitments or post-onboarding remediation windows in the MAP.

3) Retention: Eli — your proposed default (90 days operational / 365 aggregated) is acceptable for the MAP. I added a short note in the retention annex about backups and derivatives — see attached updated MAP v3 + the DPA redline PDF for inline comments.

4) Working session: Thu 11/22 10:00am PT — Neha will send invite.

Attachments: [Crestline_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 46KB), DPA_redlines_Crestline_v2.pdf (pdf, 28KB)]

If Crestline prefers a private deployment for additional residency guarantees we can scope that in parallel; that would add a short lead for networking but keeps the MAP on track.

Jordan Blake
